ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Another voice-only Alexa device does not address an obvious gap in my current setup.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try automating a lamp as a practical addition to my Alexa-capable home devices.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases focus on television and home monitoring, with no clear need for a tablet.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Apple AirPods (2nd Generation) Wireless Earbuds with Lightning Charging Case Included. Over 24 Hours of Battery Life, Effortless Setup. Bluetooth Headphones for iPhone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently looking for earbuds, and their iPhone-focused convenience is not an established fit for me.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blink Mini – Compact indoor plug-in smart security camera, 1080p HD video, night vision, motion detection, two-way audio, easy set up, Works with Alexa – 3 cameras (Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Indoor monitoring fits my interests, but I would need a specific coverage gap before adding three cameras.
